It's great that wearing a suit and tie boosts your confidence! Clothing can play a powerful role in how we perceive ourselves and how we present to the world. That said, confidence ultimately comes from within—your mindset, values, and self-acceptance matter most. If this style aligns with your identity and makes you feel empowered, that’s wonderful! It’s all about what works for *you*. If you ever want to explore other ways to cultivate confidence (like posture, mindset techniques, or personal style experimentation), I’m happy to help brainstorm ideas.
